newsitem.title: USA: U.S. blue chips inch into positive ground.
newsitem.headline: U.S. blue chips inch into positive ground.

text.p: U.S. blue chips inched into positive ground in late morning trading, boosted by strength in oil shares.
The broader market, however, remained soft amid profit taking on last week's sharp rise.
The Dow gained two points to 6705. Losing issues led gainers by a four-to-three ratio.
The Nasdaq composite was off two to 1220, hurt by weakness in computer storage and networking shares.
Better-than-expected earnings from Exxon Corp lifted oil stocks.
